name: Smart Product Showcase for WooCommerce
author: pickelements

sections.description:
Live Preview | Upgrade to PRO | Contact Us

Smart Product Showcase for WooCommerce is a versatile WordPress plugin that lets you display WooCommerce products in modern grids, sliders, and filterable layouts. With customizable design options, it’s perfect for creating responsive and engaging product showcases without any coding.

Plugin Features

  • Modern & Creative Design.
  • Clean Code.
  • Seo Friendly.
  • Responsive Layouts.
  • 9 Different Styles.
  • Slider, Grid & Filter Style.
  • Unlimited Shortcode Support.
  • Display Product by Specific Categories.
  • Display Number of Products Items.
  • Easy Shortcode.
  • Easy Options Page.
  • No Coding Required.
  • Easy Documentation.
  • 24/7 dedicated support.
  • And much more!

sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard

  1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your Plugins setting via WordPress Dashboard and activate it.
  3. After activating the plugin just copy this shortcode “[picsmartwoo id=”61″]” and paste anywhere in your post page or widgets sections to display product grid or slider.

Using FTP
1.Extract psmart-product-showcase.zip to your computer.
2.Upload the psmart-product-showcase directory to your wp-content/plugins directory.
3.After activating the plugin just copy this shortcode “[picsmartwoo id=”61″]” and paste anywhere in your post page or widgets sections to display product grid or slider.

How to use short-code?
When plugin active & all setup done please copy this shortcode “[picsmartwoo id=”61″]” & paste it anywhere in your post, page or widgets section to display product grid or slider.
